Critic · biggest remaining gapNothing pins with GL on: the SHIPPED config (--tier=auto --raster=auto -> floor, rung 0, 43x93 buffer, 30 Hz target) measured p50 49.9 / p95 66.7 / p99 100.0 / worst 133.4 ms with 57.75% dropped frames and 12 of 12 three-second windows dirty. The only clean pacing is loop-only (--raster=none), where p50/p95/p99 are 16.70/16.70/16.80 at 60 Hz and 33.30/33.40/33.50 at 30 Hz -- excellent body, but worst is 50-67 ms in EVERY run and 5-7 of ~15 three-second windows contain a drop, and it is not rendering. 4 of the 5 gate commands exit 1 (perf, budget skinned actors 14>6 floor / 14>10 low, touch worst 100.4ms + 1 stuck touch after pointercancel + TURBO 55.3mm out of reach, shoot.mjs --piece=typeface-lettering screenshot timeout at default accum=32 -- reproduced at HEAD in a clean worktree, so NOT a regression). Only simtest passes (66/66). Honesty is exemplary -- the cost curve retires the builder's own prior false claims and records the inert imposter column -- but perf.mjs and budget.mjs both tell the reader to see README ASSUMPTION A-D and README contains zero occurrences of ASSUMPTION.
